answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity on a scarce external anchor plus a rotating liveness cipher each agent must decrypt live with its anchor-bound key inside a tight window. A clone fleet forked from one wallet must keep every head awake to catch its own probe; a missed challenge forfeits the bond, so idle heads scatter on the first zephyr and earn nothing. Honest standing is a quiet whisper that accrues once, while the farm pays a distinct anchor and continuous wakefulness per head (linear cost).
